entities.name: Ahmad Awad Bin Mubarak
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Ahmad Awad bin Mubarak is a Yemeni politician who served as the prime minister of Yemen from 2024 to 2025. Before his appointment as Prime Minister, he was the former Foreign Minister of Yemen, and before that he served as Ambassador of Yemen to the United States.
